story.originalTitle: What Ferrari drivers have revealed about post-Monza talks
story.summaryEn: Ferrari Formula 1 drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc say they have cleared the air after their opening-lap Italian Grand Prix squabble, and they will continue to race without rules of engagement for now.
detailZh: 法拉利F1车手汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔声称，在意大利大奖赛首圈争执后，他们已经澄清了情况——目前他们将继续在没有交战规则的情况下比赛。
Hamilton在蒙扎1号弯从内线猛冲超越Leclerc，但在2号弯两人激烈缠斗时，他发现自己冲入了砂石地。
Leclerc赛后说“我们做得太过分了”，Hamilton对此言论不太高兴，他说：“2号弯时我在前面。到弯心时，我在前面。所以这里面没有‘我们’。”
但Hamilton表示，他们事后互相交谈以澄清情况。
“很棒的是，我们没有回避讨论。我们面对面坐着，只有他和我在那里，谈了这件事，”Hamilton周四在马德里解释道。
“我们都很开放和诚实，我们解决了问题，可以继续前进。我认为这显示了他的成熟，我认为这是健康的。这是我们随着时间建立起来的关系。
“当然，会有沮丧的时候，我相信还会有更多我们接近的时候，因为我们的速度非常接近。我们都想赢，也都想为车队做好。但是的，我认为这是非常积极的。”
Leclerc则表示，“很明显，我们永远不想看到同一车队的赛车在草地上。”
“所以，是的，我的意思是，回顾之后，我们和Lewis谈了。我当然知道我在2号弯做得太过分了，我对Lewis说了，我认为我们未来应该做什么或避免什么非常清楚。
“但我不会比我们已经说的透露更多细节。我唯一能说的是，这绝对没有影响我们之间的良好关系，也不会影响未来的任何事情。这对我来说才是最重要的，真的。
“当这些事情发生在我们的主场比赛中时，确实会在外面引起巨大的混乱。然而，我的意思是，从外面看比赛，其他队友之间也有一些摩擦。
“人们最终只谈论Lewis和我，我认为这不太对。但这并不意味着我们做的一切都很完美。我在2号弯就没有。
“为此，在回顾图像后，我立即对Lewis非常明确地说了。”
Leclerc再次强调，法拉利车手受到了不成比例的关注，而其他队友也在激烈争斗。
“再说一次，我需要小心，因为这不是要淡化事情的发展方式，看到Lewis冲入砂石地等是不可接受的，”Leclerc说。
“但可以肯定的是，事实上，我们这边的比例比其他两支车队要大得多……我没有看完整场比赛……但我看到其他两支在顶部争斗的车队，周围的噪音没有那么多。
“所以，当你为法拉利开车时，事情的比例肯定要大得多，尤其是在蒙扎。但这并不是要淡化发生的事情。这不是应该再次发生的事情。”
蒙扎之后，有消息透露法拉利车手之间“没有规则”，这让人非常惊讶。
Hamilton在蒙扎后的周一与车队老板Fred Vasseur进行了交谈，此前他在赛后媒体采访中大部分时间都在呼吁法拉利对其运营和执行周末的方式做出重大改变。
“这真的很积极，”Hamilton谈到蒙扎之后的日子时说。
“我周一和Fred谈了，我们只是在澄清……讨论……自然，我们总是会有不同的意见，但最终，我们走到一起，找到前进的道路。
“这就是过去15个月左右我们取得的积极进展。我们已经达到了内部沟通非常好的地步，我和Charles之间也是如此。”
当被问及引入交战规则——类似于Hamilton在梅赛德斯期间一直有的——是否是那些与Vasseur对话的一部分时，Hamilton说“不是”。
当被问及为什么不是时，Hamilton回答说：“现在我只是试图专注于这个周末有一个更好的周末。
“我相信在某个阶段我们会讨论如何做得更好，但我们没有太多时间扭转局面。你不可能在两天内改变事情。”
当The 比赛问及法拉利是否能迅速实施Hamilton在蒙扎后呼吁的那种沟通和程序变革时，他回答说：“我认为这是一个长期的过程。这不是我们这个周末就能改变的。
“有大量的变动部分。有很多人。有一种存在了很长时间的文化。移动大块的东西并不容易。
“我们只是一步一步来。它从讨论开始。它从承认开始，我们在内部已经承认了。
“然后就是一起找出解决方案。这不会一夜之间发生。我们可能会尝试一些事情，仍然不会好，但我们最终会达到我们需要的地步。”
Hamilton继续公开坚称，他在法拉利呼吁的任何改变都不包括要求车队优先考虑他而不是Leclerc。相反，这一切都是为了确保车队团结一致，以便利用梅赛德斯的任何失误。
“我的意思是，这实际上并不是我一直在要求的，”他说。
“这真的只是确保我们执行，以确保我们为车队取得最好的结果，而不是我们互相争斗，最终获得第四和第五。
“也许你们可以合作，获得一个领奖台，拿到更多积分。我认为在这一点上，
“梅赛德斯，如果你看上一场比赛，在直道上每圈快了十分之六。几乎在大多数其他赛道上，我们在直道上就损失了十分之三或十分之四。
“所以我认为，考虑到我们有那样的劣势，我们做得非常出色，我们继续改进赛车。我们对引擎进行了改进。我们知道最后一次升级不会是银弹，完全弥补那个差距。但对我来说，看到我们不断前进是非常积极的，他们只是非常非常快，这并不容易。
“所以正如我所说，与其关注他们，他们目前不是我的焦点。我认为我们的焦点应该只是我们如何在自己的周末做到最好、执行得最好，因为会有他们表现出色的周末，也会有他们可能失误的周末。
“只要我们专注于我们的稳定性，努力优化我们的周末，也许会有某个时刻我们能够利用他们的缺点。”
detailEn: Ferrari Formula 1 drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc claim they've cleared the air after their opening lap Italian Grand Prix squabble - and they'll continue to race without rules of engagement for now.
Hamilton dived down the inside of Leclerc at Turn 1 at Monza but found himself in the gravel at Turn 2 as they battled each other hard.
Leclerc said "we went too far" after the race, a remark Hamilton wasn't too pleased about saying "I was ahead in Turn 2. By the apex, I was ahead. So there was no 'we' in it."
But Hamilton said they spoke to each other afterwards to clear the air.
"What's great is that there was no shying away from having a discussion. We sat face-to-face, just him and I and talked about it," Hamilton explained on Thursday in Madrid.
"We were just both open and honest and we squashed it and we can move on. I think that shows the maturity from him and I think it's healthy. It's a relationship we have built over time.

"Of course, there's going to be frustrations and I'm sure there'll be more times where we're close because we're very close in pace. We both want to win just as much as each other and we both want to do well for the team as well. But yeah, I think it's a real positive."
For his part, Leclerc said it's "clear that we never want to see a car of the same team in the grass.
"So yeah, I mean, after reviewing, we spoke with Lewis. I obviously know I went too far in Turn 2 and I said it to Lewis and I think it's very clear what we should do or should avoid going forward.

"But I won't go into much more detail than what we've said. The only thing I can say is that it definitely did not affect the good relationship that we have and it will not affect anything going forward. And that is the most important for me, really.
"When these things happen at our home race, then it does [make] a huge mess outside. However, I mean, looking at the race from outside, there's also been some friction between other team-mates.
"The only thing [people] end up speaking of is Lewis and I, which I don't think is quite right. But that doesn't mean we did everything perfectly. I didn't in Turn 2.
"And for that, I've been straight away very clear with Lewis after reviewing the images."
Leclerc doubled down on this assertion that a disproportionate focus had been placed on the Ferrari drivers, when other team-mates had been fighting each other hard too.
"Again, I need to be careful with that because it's not to minimise the way that this unfolded, it's not acceptable to see Lewis going in the gravel, etc." Leclerc said.

"But for sure, the proportions, as a matter of fact, are much bigger on our side compared to the two other teams that have had some…I didn't follow the whole race…but the two other teams I saw that were fighting at the top, there wasn't as much noise around it.

"So surely the proportions that it takes when you are driving for Ferrari is much bigger and particularly if we're in Monza. But that's not to minimise what happened. It's not something that should happen again."
There was much surprise after Monza when it was revealed the Ferrari drivers have "no rules" for racing each other.

Hamilton spoke to team boss Fred Vasseur on the Monday after Monza, having spent much of his post-race media sessions calling for Ferrari to make big changes to the way it operates and executes its weekends.
It's been really positive," Hamilton said of the days after Monza.
"I spoke to Fred on Monday, and we're just clearing up…discussion of…naturally, we're going to always have different opinions, but at the end of the day, we come together and we find a way forward.
"That's the positives of where we've got to over the past 15 months or whatever it is. We've got to a place where we have really great communication internally, and the same with me and Charles."
Asked if the introduction of rules of engagement - similar to what Hamilton had throughout his time at Mercedes - was part of those conversations with Vasseur, Hamilton said "It was not".
Asked why they weren't, Hamilton replied: "Right now I'm just trying to focus on having a better weekend, this weekend.
"I'm sure at some stage we'll discuss how we can be better, but we've not had a lot of time to turn around. You can't change things in two days."

Asked by The Race if Ferrari could quickly implement the kind of communication and procedural changes Hamilton was calling for after Monza, he replied: "I think it's a longer-term process. It's not something we can just change into this weekend.
"There's a huge amount of moving parts. There's a lot of people. There's a culture that's been there for a long, long time. Moving big pieces is not so easy.
"We just take it one step at a time. It starts with discussing it. It starts with the acknowledgement, which internally we have.
"Then it just comes to working out solutions together. It just doesn't happen overnight. We'll probably try things and it still won't be good, but we'll eventually get to the point we need."

Hamilton continues to insist publicly that any change he's calling for at Ferrari doesn't include asking the team to prioritise him over Leclerc. Instead it's all about ensuring the team all pulls together so it can make the most of any slip-ups from Mercedes.
"I mean, that's not actually really what I've been asking for," he said.
"It's really just making sure we're executing to make sure we get the best result for the team instead of us working against each other and finishing fourth and fifth.
"Maybe you can work together and get a podium and pull off more points. I think at this point,
"Mercedes, if you look at the last race, there was six tenths of a lap quicker on the straights. Pretty much most of the other tracks, there's three or four tenths we're losing just on the straights.

"So I think we've done a really great job given that we've had that deficit and we continue to make improvements to the car. We've made improvements to the engine. We knew that the last upgrade wasn't going to be a silver bullet and close that gap completely. But for me, it's really positive to see us continuously stepping forward and they are just very, very quick and it's not easy.

"So as I said, rather than focus on them, they're not a focus for me at the moment. I think our focus should just be how we can do the best and execute the best on our weekends because there'll be weekends where they're exceptional and there'll be weekends where they maybe drop the ball.
"As long as we just focus on our consistency and trying to optimise our weekends, maybe there's going to be a moment where we are able to capitalise on perhaps their shortcomings."

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.

relatedItems.titleZh: 马来西亚大奖赛回归在即，车手期待雪邦或将上演混乱激战
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阔别近十年后，F1将于2026年重返雪邦，替代被取消的巴林和沙特大奖赛，车手们对这条久未造访的赛道展开了各自的预测。
relatedItems.originalTitle: 'Chaotic racing'? - What F1 drivers expect from Malaysia return
relatedItems.summaryEn: Formula 1 will return to Sepang in 2026 after nearly a decade away, replacing the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, and drivers have been sharing their early predictions about the challenge ahead.
keyPointsZh: 大部分车手在阿塞拜疆-马来西亚-新加坡三连赛开始前已在模拟器上为雪邦做了准备
威廉姆斯的模拟数据显示，雪邦在2026年赛道中的能源管理需求约为中等水平，与加拿大和奥地利站相近
世界冠军兰多·诺里斯曾在2017年为迈凯伦车手阿隆索和范多恩担任模拟器支持工作
keyPointsEn: Most drivers had already completed simulator preparations for Sepang before the Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header began
Williams's data places Sepang around average in energy management demands for 2026 circuits, similar to Canada and Austria
World champion Lando Norris provided sim support for McLaren's race drivers Fernando Alonso and Stoffel Vandoorne the last time F1 raced there in 2017
